about.title: About
about.content:
About Ovents

Thoughtful Planning. Personal Service. Exceptional Attention to Detail.

We are a professional, London based company providing event planning and coordination for corporate and social events. Our work includes corporate events, baby and bridal showers, graduate balls, birthdays, parties, stag dos and weddings.

Every service is tailored to your needs. Although we are London based, we offer planning and coordination throughout Hertfordshire, Essex, Surrey, Kent, Sussex and across the UK.

Who we are

Ovents LTD is a wedding and event planning company built around clear communication, reliable delivery and respect for your vision.

Dependability

We are a company that can be counted upon. We provide timely, professional service and aim to accommodate last-minute requests where possible.

Customer commitment

Our focus is you. We are committed to customer satisfaction. If you are happy, so are we.

Our promise

We aim to provide a professional, quality service that meets your expectations. We use your feedback to improve how we work.

We offer competitive prices and will be happy to price match if you find a comparable deal.

Book a consultation

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.content:
Last updated: 18 November 2026

Ovents LTD (“Ovents”, “we”, “us”) plans weddings, corporate events and private parties across the UK. This policy explains what personal information we collect, why we use it, and the choices you have. We are the controller of your personal data under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018.

Who we are

Ovents LTD, a company registered in England and Wales (company number 11531903).
Registered office: [Registered office address to be confirmed]
Email: info@ovents.co.uk
Phone: +44 7447 462409
ICO registration number: [To be confirmed]

What we collect

When you make an enquiry (through our website form, email, phone or WhatsApp): your name, email address, phone number, the type of event, date, location, approximate guest numbers, budget range if you share it, and anything else you tell us in your message.

When you book with us: the details we need to plan and run your event, such as billing details, venue and supplier information, schedules, guest numbers and, where relevant, dietary or accessibility requirements you choose to share. Dietary or health information is only used to plan your event, and only with your agreement.

When you use our website: technical information such as your IP address, browser and device type, and pages visited. With your consent we use analytics cookies (see Cookies below).

When you contact us on social media: your profile name and the messages you send us.

How we use it and our lawful basis

  • Replying to your enquiry and preparing a proposal. Lawful basis: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract.
  • Planning and delivering your event, invoicing and taking payment. Lawful basis: performance of our contract with you.
  • Keeping financial records. Lawful basis: legal obligation.
  • Website analytics to understand how people use our site. Lawful basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
  • Sending occasional news or offers by email. Only if you have opted in, and you can unsubscribe at any time. Lawful basis: consent.
  • Using photos from your event on our website or social media. Only with your permission, as agreed in our client contract.
  • Keeping our website secure and preventing spam. Lawful basis: our legitimate interests.

We never sell your personal information.

Who we share it with

We only share what’s needed, with:

  • Suppliers and venues working on your event (for example caterers, florists, photographers), so they can deliver their part;
  • Service providers who run our business systems, such as our email provider (Google Workspace), website host (Hostinger), Google Analytics (with your consent), accounting software and WhatsApp (Meta) if you message us there;
  • Professional advisers such as our accountant, and authorities where the law requires it.

Some of these providers may store data outside the UK. Where they do, we rely on safeguards approved under UK law, such as the UK adequacy regulations or the International Data Transfer Agreement/Addendum.

How long we keep it

  • Enquiries that don’t lead to a booking: up to 12 months after our last contact.
  • Client and booking records: 6 years after the event, to meet tax and accounting rules.
  • Analytics data: up to 14 months (Google Analytics retention setting).
  • Marketing consent: until you unsubscribe.

Cookies

Our website uses essential cookies so it works properly. With your consent, we also use analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to see which pages are useful. You can accept or reject non-essential cookies in the cookie banner on any page of this site. Rejecting them won’t affect how the site works.

Your rights

You have the right to:

  • ask for a copy of your personal information;
  • ask us to correct or delete it;
  • object to or restrict how we use it;
  • ask us to transfer it to you or another organisation;
  • withdraw consent at any time, where we rely on consent.

Email info@ovents.co.uk to use any of these rights. We’ll reply within one month.

Complaints

If you’re unhappy with how we’ve handled your data, please contact us first. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO): ico.org.uk, 0303 123 1113.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page, with the date it was last updated.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.content:
Where is Ovents based?

Ovents is based in London, United Kingdom.

Does Ovents provide services across the UK?

Yes. We plan and coordinate weddings, corporate events and private celebrations across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

What types of events do you plan?

Weddings, corporate events and private parties, including birthdays, anniversaries and milestone celebrations.

What is the difference between wedding planning and coordination?

Planning covers research, suppliers and decisions before the day. Coordination focuses on delivering the plan on the day, managing suppliers and the schedule. We offer both.

Can we book coordination without full planning?

Yes. Tell us what you have already booked and we will outline on-the-day or partial support.

How far in advance should we enquire?

Earlier is helpful for full planning, but contact us with your date and we will advise what is possible.

Can you work with suppliers we have already booked?

Yes. We coordinate with your existing suppliers and fill gaps where you need extra support.

How do we request a quote?

Submit the contact form with your event type, date, location and guest numbers if known.

How does the consultation process work?

We review your enquiry, arrange a conversation to understand your plans and explain how we can help. A formal quote follows when scope is clear.
